skill_name: Create a mobile app wireframe of a simple quiz game.
workflow: The mobile app wireframe of the quiz game will include three main sections: the start screen with the game title, instructions, and settings; the question and answer screen; and the game over screen with final results, a button to restart the game, and a button to submit the results on a leaderboard.
